'''Hadran''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] who was stationed on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] during the [[Invasion of Manaan]]. He was an armormech specialist.<ref name="Encounter" />
